triage_records.title: Sodium and Potassium Intake and Mortality Among US Adults
triage_records.relevance_rationale: The paper reports original empirical data from a large prospective cohort (NHANES III) examining the association between sodium intake and all-cause mortality. Although the study population includes both hypertensive and normotensive adults, the abstract explicitly states that the findings 'did not differ significantly by... hypertension status.' This implies that the association observed in the general population is consistent across the normotensive subgroup, providing direct empirical evidence relevant to the specific question of whether sodium intake levels are associated with mortality in normotensive adults.
